newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE cocoa regains some ground, still down.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE cocoa regains some ground, still down.

text.p: LIFFE cocoa futures regained some strength in the London afternoon to finish Thursday with pared losses as buyers returned after a selling spree in the morning.
The recovery was also helped by persistent manufacturer support at the lows.
"The selling this morning was a bit provocative. There was no particular reason for the market to fall," said one trader.
Benchmark September finished the day just three stg lower at 1,054 after a low of 1,042 and a high of 1,061.
"Trade sellers emerged after it became apparent that September won't break the 1,060 level," one trader said earlier. He said the strong pound sterling also did not help the situation.

Sterling, which recovered back above 2.96 German marks in late morning after shedding a pfenning on news Bank of England raised official interest rates by 25 basis points to 6.75 percent, fell sharply in the afternoon.
On Wednesday, sterling eclipsed Tuesday's six-year high to reach a fresh peak at 2.9760 marks.
A strong sterling deters many European buyers but attracts selling from the origins.
Volume reached 6,454 lots. Sept/Dec switches were traded at 23-24 stg, little changed from previous sessions.
